M15_S01.summary: The association of mental factors follows a fixed rule: seven go with every citta, six occasionals as the case requires, fourteen only with unwholesome cittas and nineteen only with beautiful ones.
body: Cetasikasaṅgaha, the combination of mental factors, answers one question: how do these 52 mental factors combine with one another and with consciousness in each class of citta?

The summary verse runs: 'Seven are associated with every kind of citta. The six Occasionals are associated as the case requires. Fourteen are associated only with unwholesome cittas. The nineteen Beautiful factors arise only in beautiful cittas.'
The ethically variable group has 13 factors = 7 universals + 6 occasionals. They are called 'common to the other' because they occur in wholesome and unwholesome cittas alike, as the case may be.

The range of the occasionals, counted over the 121 cittas: initial application occurs in 55 cittas, sustained application in 66, rapture in 51, desire-to-act in 101 (69 when counted over the 89 cittas); energy occurs in 105 cittas (73 over the 89), being absent from 16 — the 10 sense consciousnesses, five-door adverting, the 2 receiving cittas and the 3 investigating cittas.

By level of absorption the jhāna factors combine thus: the first jhāna has five — initial application, sustained application, rapture, happiness and concentration; the second has four — sustained application, rapture, happiness, concentration; the third has three — rapture, happiness, concentration; the fourth has two — happiness and concentration; the fifth has equanimity and concentration.

M15_S02.summary: The unwholesome factors each have their fixed range: the delusion four in all twelve cittas, greed in eight, wrong view in four, conceit in four, the hatred four in two, sloth-torpor in five prompted cittas and doubt in one.
body: The four factors of the delusion group — delusion, shamelessness, fearlessness of wrongdoing and restlessness — are the unwholesome universals: they are found in all twelve unwholesome cittas.
Greed occurs only in the 8 greed-rooted cittas. Wrong view occurs in the 4 greed-rooted cittas associated with wrong view. Conceit occurs in the 4 greed-rooted cittas dissociated from wrong view.
Hatred, envy, avarice and worry occur in the 2 hatred-rooted cittas. Of these, envy, avarice and worry arise with hatred one at a time, according to the occasion — never all three together.
Sloth and torpor arise with the prompted unwholesome cittas — five in all: the 4 prompted greed-rooted cittas and the 1 prompted hatred-rooted citta.
Doubt occurs only in the delusion-rooted citta associated with doubt, a single citta.

Some factors arise only in particular cittas: the 3 abstinences (right speech, right action, right livelihood) arise according to the occasion in sense-sphere beautiful wholesome cittas or in supramundane cittas; compassion and appreciative joy arise according to the occasion in form-sphere jhāna cittas or in sense-sphere wholesome and functional cittas.

The totals by class of citta: an unwholesome citta can have 27 factors (13 ethically variable + 14 unwholesome); a sense-sphere beautiful citta 38 (13 + 25); a jhāna citta 35 (13 + 22, the 3 abstinences excluded); a supramundane citta 36 (13 + 23, the 2 illimitables excluded).

M15_S03.summary: Citta and cetasikas arise together, cease together, share one object and one base: consciousness, feeling, perception and formations are four inseparable mental aggregates.
body: Paramatthasacca is ultimate truth, the real nature of things: parama means final, unalterable, incapable of turning into something else; attha means thing or matter. Paramattha is thus what cannot be altered although it still arises and passes away — absolute truth in the sense of suchness, a thing being just as it is, not in the sense of being permanent.

The essential nature of citta has three aspects: it is itself of the nature of knowing an object; it is the cause by which its mental factors know that same object; and it is what makes living beings and even lifeless things appear in their endless variety.

Mentality and materiality are two distinct components, but mentality arises along with consciousness: it comprises feeling (the mental factor of feeling), perception (the mental factor of perception) and the formations (the remaining 50 mental factors), all arising together with consciousness.
Where consciousness is, mentality is: these four are INSEPARABLE, and they are called the FOUR MENTAL AGGREGATES — feeling, perception, formations and consciousness.

Citta and cetasikas arise together, cease together, know the same object and depend on the same base. Their combination is therefore a law of ultimate realities, not an arrangement anyone can alter at will.

M15_S04.summary: A greed-rooted citta has 19 to 21 factors with joy and 18 to 20 with equanimity, a hatred-rooted citta 20 to 22, and each delusion-rooted citta exactly 15.
body: Each of the 8 greed-rooted cittas = 13 ethically variable factors + the 4 factors of the delusion group + greed, together with wrong view (when associated with view) or conceit (when dissociated from it).

A greed-rooted citta accompanied by joy and associated with wrong view has 19 factors when unprompted; when prompted it adds sloth and torpor, making 21. When dissociated from view, conceit simply replaces wrong view and the counts stay the same: 19 and 21.

Greed-rooted cittas accompanied by equanimity lack the factor of rapture: associated with view and unprompted, 18; associated with view and prompted, 20; dissociated from view and unprompted, 18; dissociated and prompted, 20.

The 2 hatred-rooted cittas, accompanied by displeasure and so without rapture: the unprompted one has 20 factors = 12 ethically variable (13 less rapture) + 4 of the delusion group + hatred + one of envy, avarice or worry as the occasion demands; the prompted one adds sloth and torpor, making 22.

The 2 delusion-rooted cittas, accompanied by equanimity and so without rapture, have 15 factors each = the 7 universals + initial application, sustained application and decision + the 4 factors of the delusion group + doubt (in the first) or, in the second, restlessness itself serving as the governing factor.

M15_S05.summary: Among the eighteen rootless cittas the sense consciousnesses have only the seven universals, receiving and investigating ten or eleven, the two advertings eleven, and the smile-producing citta twelve.
body: The rootless cittas, those without any of the six roots, number 18: 7 unwholesome-resultant, 8 wholesome-resultant and 3 functional.

The five pairs of sense consciousness (eye, ear, nose, tongue and body, wholesome- and unwholesome-resultant) have only the 7 universal factors. This is a LAW OF ULTIMATE REALITIES: at least eight components must combine for a mental phenomenon to arise — the eight inseparable mental components — just as materiality has its eight inseparables. No occasional factor accompanies them, because the sense consciousnesses perform their simple function by the bare impact of object on base, needing no further support.
The 2 receiving cittas have 10 factors: the 7 universals + initial application, sustained application and decision.

The 2 investigating cittas accompanied by equanimity (wholesome- and unwholesome-resultant) have 10 factors: the 7 universals + initial application, sustained application and decision (without energy, rapture or desire), since they merely examine the object. The investigating citta accompanied by joy (wholesome-resultant) has 11, adding rapture, because its object is more beautiful and brilliant.

Five-door adverting and mind-door adverting have 11 factors: the 7 universals + initial application, sustained application, decision and energy — energy being needed because they have to appraise and determine the object within the process.
The smile-producing citta (functional, accompanied by joy) has 12 factors: the 13 ethically variable less desire-to-act, since the smile of an Arahant does not spring from any wish for pleasure.

M15_S06.summary: Sense-sphere beautiful cittas carry 38 down to 36 factors, jhāna cittas 35 down to 30, and supramundane cittas 36 down to 33 — the abstinences and illimitables appearing only with the appropriate object.
body: The 8 great wholesome sense-sphere cittas: accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge (unprompted and prompted alike) = 13 ethically variable + 25 beautiful = 38 factors. Accompanied by joy but dissociated from knowledge: less the faculty of wisdom = 37. Accompanied by equanimity and associated with knowledge: 12 ethically variable (less rapture) + 25 = 37. Accompanied by equanimity and dissociated from knowledge = 36. The sense-sphere beautiful resultant and functional cittas combine in the same way.
No unwholesome factor occurs in a wholesome citta, and the 19 beautiful universals are present in every beautiful citta without exception.

The 3 abstinences (right speech, right action, right livelihood) are NOT present simultaneously, since each has its own distinct object: the factor of right speech arises only when there is an occasion to keep one's speech right, and likewise right action and right livelihood each arise on their own occasion.

The sublime jhāna cittas: the first jhāna = 13 ethically variable + 22 beautiful (25 less the 3 abstinences) = 35 factors. The abstinences are absent because the object of jhāna is a kasiṇa, not an occasion for restraint — though it must be said that no one lacking virtue could attain jhāna at all.

The illimitables (compassion and appreciative joy) do not occur in jhāna cittas whose object is a kasiṇa. If one develops compassion taking suffering beings as the object, then on attaining the first jhāna only compassion is present; if one takes happy beings as the object, only appreciative joy. Only one of the two can arise in any one attainment.

The higher jhānas shed one factor at a time: the second jhāna has 34 (without initial application), the third 33 (without sustained application), the fourth 32 (without rapture) and the fifth 30. The form-sphere resultant cittas have 33, 32, 31, 30 and 30 respectively.

The supramundane cittas (4 paths and 4 fruitions): a first-jhāna path citta = 13 ethically variable + 23 beautiful (25 less the 2 illimitables) = 36 factors — and here all 3 abstinences are present together, because the object of the path citta is Nibbāna. A second-jhāna path citta has 35, a third 34 and a fourth 33.
